headline: Certified recount on statutory question required by HB 1300, Chapter 324: yes 18895, no 13244.
summary: City Clerk Daniel Healey explained the reason for the recount and the day's procedures. Members then voted to certify the recount results as read, making them the official vote.
decisions: Certified the recount results on the statutory question required by HB 1300, Chapter 324, 2026, as the official vote: yes 18895, no 13244, undervote 1584. Motion carried.

decision_evidence.quote: MOTION BY ALDERMAN CLEMONS TO CERTIFY RECOUNT RESULTS AS READ BY THE CITY CLERK AND DECLARE THE RECOUNT ON VOTES CAST FOR STATUTORY QUESTION REQUIRED BY HB 1300, CHAPTER 324, 2026, AS READ TO BE THE OFFICIAL VOTE (YES: 18895; NO: 13244; UNDERVOTE: 1584) MOTION CARRIED

decision_titles: Recount of statutory question required by HB 1300, Chapter 324
plain_text:
A Special Meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Saturday, November 14, 2026, at 9:00 a.m. at Nashua High 
School South in the cafeteria. 
  
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Daniel Healey Clerked. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Daniel Healey; Alderman-at-Large Alicia Gregg led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.  
 
The roll call was taken with 15 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons, Alderman Klee, 
Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Gregg, Alderman Dowd, 
Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott, Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Morgan, Alderman Lopez, 
Alderman Wilshire.  
 
Corporation Counsel Steve Bolton and Deputy City Clerk Roger Ordway was also in attendance. 
 
COMMUNICATIONS 
 
From: Daniel Healey, City Clerk 
Re: Recount request for Statutory Question Required by HB1300, Chapter 324, 2026   
 
Without objection, President Wilshire accepted the communication and placed it on file.  
 
DISCUSSION 
 
• Canvas of Returns on November 3, 2026 Municipal General Election Request for Recount of Votes Cast for 
Statutory Question Required by HB 1300, Chapter 324, 2026 
 
President Wilshire turned the recount meeting over to City Clerk Healey. 
 
City Clerk Healey discussed the reason for the recount and the procedures for the day. 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN CLEMONS TO CERTIFY RECOUNT RESULTS AS READ BY THE CITY CLERK AND 
DECLARE THE RECOUNT ON VOTES CAST FOR STATUTORY QUESTION REQUIRED BY HB 1300, CHAPTER 
324, 2026, AS READ TO BE THE OFFICIAL VOTE (YES:  18895; NO:  13244; UNDERVOTE:  1584) 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
ADJOURNMENT 
 
MOTION BY ALDERMAN CLEMONS THAT THE NOVEMBER 14, 2026, SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF 
ALDERMEN BE ADJOURNED 
MOTION CARRIED 
 
The meeting was declared adjourned at 12:27 p.m. 
             
 
             Attest:  Daniel Healey, City Clerk
